description: This file implements the MessageControl class within the WPEFramework plugin namespace, handling message control functionalities such as attaching/detaching instances, enabling/disabling message types, and dispatching messages via a worker thread.

classes.name: MessageControlImplementation
classes.description: Implements message control functionalities including managing message instances, enabling/disabling message types, and message dispatching within the plugin namespace.

classes.name: WorkerThread
classes.description: A nested thread class responsible for executing the Dispatch method in a separate thread context.

classes.name: MessageSettings
classes.description: Singleton class that loads and provides access to message settings such as identifiers, paths, and socket ports.

methods.name: Callback
methods.description: Sets or replaces the callback object used for message collection and manages thread state accordingly.

methods.name: Attach
methods.description: Adds an instance with the specified ID to the message client.

methods.name: Detach
methods.description: Removes an instance with the specified ID from the message client.

methods.name: Enable
methods.description: Enables or disables a specific message type, category, and module.

methods.name: Controls
methods.description: Retrieves current message control settings and returns an iterator over them.

methods.name: Dispatch
methods.description: Waits for message updates and calls the callback with each message's data.
